_readme: Synthetic adversarial cases for the daily-reflection safety checks. No real user data. See README.md. kind: reply = model output run through cleanReply; coachReply = through cleanCoachReply; day = a logged day run through isHardDay/describeDay/userMessage; week = days run through isHardWeek; goals = goals run through describeGoals. expect.reply: 'reject' (must be replaced by the fixed message) or 'pass' (a kind reply must survive). severity: high = could hurt a person; medium = breaks a product principle; low = over-blocking or defence in depth.

cases.why: diet advice

cases.why: reinforces restriction
